title: Sports & Fitness Talk
description: Learn the vocabulary to talk about your favourite sports, describe physical activities, discuss match results, and chat about health and fitness. Designed for A2 learners who want to join sports conversations with ease.

content.content: {"time":1700040001000,"blocks":[{"id":"sA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"English has specific verbs for different sports. You play team sports with a ball, you go to activities ending in -ing, and you do other sports."}},{"id":"sD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"play / go / do","level":3}},{"id":"sG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["PLAY: football, tennis, basketball, volleyball, golf, chess","GO: swimming, cycling, running, hiking, skiing, jogging","DO: yoga, karate, gymnastics, athletics, aerobics"]}},{"id":"sJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Note: Some sports can use two verbs — e.g. 'go boxing' and 'do boxing' are both acceptable."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

questions.text: Which verb is correct? 'She ___ swimming three times a week.'

Let's learn how to describe sporting events."}},{"id":"mD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Results Vocabulary","level":3}},{"id":"mG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["win / beat — победить / обыграть","lose — проиграть","draw / tie — сыграть вничью","score a goal / point — забить гол / набрать очко","The final score was 3–1. — Финальный счёт был 3–1."]}},{"id":"mJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Reactions","level":3}},{"id":"mM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["What a game! — Вот это игра!","That was brilliant / terrible!","Did you see that goal?","I can't believe they lost!","They played really well / badly."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

phrases.text: The game ended in a draw.
He scored in the last minute!
Did you watch the match last night?

content.text: Spain ___ Germany 3–1 in the final. It was an amazing game! Rodriguez ___ two goals in the first half. At the end everyone was ___ because Spain played so well.

Let's learn how to discuss keeping fit in English."}},{"id":"fD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Fitness Vocabulary","level":3}},{"id":"fG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["work out — тренироваться","warm up / cool down — разминаться / восстанавливаться","stretch — растягиваться","build muscle — наращивать мышцы","lose weight — сбросить вес","get fit — привести себя в форму","stay active — оставаться активным"]}},{"id":"fJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Talking About Routines","level":3}},{"id":"fM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I work out three times a week.","My goal is to run a 5K.","I've started going to the gym.","I try to stay active every day."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I try to work out at least three times a week. I usually go running in the morning and do yoga in the evening. My goal is to run a half marathon by the end of the year.

pairs.right: do light exercise before the main workout

questions.text: Which sentence correctly describes a fitness goal?
options: My goal is to run a 5K.
